title: Need more available weight sizes for elderly
text: Need more available weight sizes for elderly. I already have a weighted blanket but by a different distributor and I bought this blanket for my mom.  This blanket is way too heavy.  The problem is why doesn’t weighted blankets make weight sizes for the weak and fragile elderly? Their bones can not handle that much weight and if you buy a kids 7lb blanket it’s not big enough to cover the adults body.  There has to be some one who will have the blanket weight and size needed for the elderly so they can enjoy these too.
